_comment: Key dates for two school-leaver years: starting university in 2027 (Year 12 in 2026) and in 2028 (Year 11 in 2026). Every date is quoted from the university's, UAC's or the provider's own page and was matched word for word by code in the desktop browser on checkedOn (docs/review/schedule-2026-11-05.md). 'repeats' marks a 2026 date that the 2028 view shows as last year's date, never as a 2027 date: no 2027 round had been published when this was checked. Plain-English fields (what, for, status) are our summaries of the quotes.

year11.text: Year 11 results count. Macquarie, Western Sydney and Wollongong read them for early offers, and so does UNSW Gateway.
Keep a list of what you do outside class in Years 11 and 12 — sport, volunteering, part-time work, leadership. Macquarie asks for it.
Use the summer holidays before Year 12. They are the easiest time to try a field.
Go to open days in Year 11 (last year they ran from late June to early September), not in Year 12.
Ask your careers adviser now about school work experience and programs only schools can nominate for.
Early-offer applications for 2028 entry should open around April–June 2027. Check each university's page then — the dates below are last year's.

afterSchool.name: ASD Apprenticeship Program
afterSchool.who: School leavers and others. Australian citizens with a Year 12 certificate; you must pass a security assessment.
afterSchool.what: A paid job: work 3 to 4 days a week and study a Certificate IV (ICT or project management) over 18 months. Starting salary $65,286 plus super.

quotes.text: Apprentices work 3 to 4 days per week, with the rest of your time dedicated to completing a Certificate IV over an 18-month period.
Successful candidates commence their apprenticeship on a salary of $65,286 (including 4% Service Allowance), plus 15.4% superannuation.
Applications for the 2028 ASD Apprenticeship Program will open in early 2027.

afterSchool.name: TechBee — HCLTech's early career program
afterSchool.who: People who have finished high school and want full-time work.
afterSchool.what: 12 months of training for an entry-level technology role, then a job.
afterSchool.when: Apply through HCLTech's Australian careers page; no intake date is published.

quotes.text: A career program for individuals seeking full-time opportunities after completing high school.
Candidates undergo a 12-month training program for entry-level engineering roles.

afterSchool.name: IT Traineeship with Microsoft
afterSchool.who: Anyone hired by one of the program's host employers.
afterSchool.what: A paid job with a Microsoft partner while you complete a Certificate IV in Information Technology and Microsoft certifications.
afterSchool.when: Positions appear on MEGT's job board through the year.

quotes.text: You complete your Certificate IV in Information Technology while working with your host employer.

afterSchool.name: HCLTech TechBee at Macquarie
afterSchool.who: 1st or 2nd year Macquarie students in Information Technology, Software Engineering or Computer Science who are Australian citizens or permanent residents.
afterSchool.what: Paid part-time work at HCLTech while you study, with mentoring, then a full-time job when you finish.
afterSchool.when: Register your interest once you are enrolled.

quotes.text: 1st or 2nd year university students enrolled in a Bachelor of Information Technology, Software Engineering or Computer Science
Paid part-time work

afterSchool.name: ASD Cadetship Program
afterSchool.who: Australian citizens studying a STEM degree, after at least one semester, with a credit average.
afterSchool.what: Paid work while you finish your degree, plus $800 per subject passed, then a full-time job.
afterSchool.when: Opens early each year. Starting uni in 2028, the earliest you could apply is early 2029, after a semester — our reading.

quotes.text: Have completed a minimum of one semester of their STEM degree at time of application.
Hold and maintain a minimum credit average at time of application and for the duration of the program.

afterSchool.name: APS Data and Digital Cadet Program
afterSchool.who: Australian citizens who have completed one year of a digital or technical degree when the program starts.
afterSchool.what: Guaranteed part-time government work while you finish your degree, an allowance of up to $800 per unit, then a full-time job.
afterSchool.when: Applications open 1 April 2027 (for programs starting in 2028). Starting uni in 2028, you would be eligible for the round after — our reading.

quotes.text: guaranteed part-time employment while you finish your degree and full-time employment on completion
have completed one year or equivalent of a digital or technical degree at the commencement of the program
Applications for the Data and Digital Cadet Program will open 1 April 2027.

afterSchool.name: Azure for Students
afterSchool.who: Full-time university or college students aged 18 or over — not high school students.
afterSchool.what: Free cloud services and credit for learning.
afterSchool.when: Once you are 18 and enrolled at university.

quotes.text: You must affirm that you're age 18 or older and attend an accredited, degree-granting, two-year or four-year educational institution where you're a full-time student.
